title: MY PETS
goal: Students can describe pets, talk about what pets can do, and say how to care for them.
goal_vi: Học sinh có thể mô tả thú cưng, nói về những gì thú cưng có thể làm và cách chăm sóc chúng.

big_question.en: What kind of pet do you like to have? Why?
big_question.vi: Em thích có loại thú cưng nào? Tại sao?

What does a cat like to eat?
How do you take care of an animal?

phonics.tip_vi: Âm /p/ là âm bật hơi. Khi phát âm, bạn khép môi lại rồi bật hơi mạnh ra.

patterns.vi: Đây là + thú cưng của tôi.
examples: This is my dog, Lucky.
This is my new pet fish.
This is my sister's rabbit.
I have got a cat.
She has got a hamster.
They have got some fish.

patterns.vi: Thú cưng của tôi + tính từ.
examples: My dog is friendly.
The kitten is small and cute.
My turtle is slow but smart.

patterns.vi: Nó có thể + động từ hành động.
examples: It can run fast.
My bird can sing beautifully.
The puppy can play with a ball.

patterns.vi: Nó không thể + động từ hành động.
examples: A fish can't walk.
My hamster can't fly.
A rabbit can't talk.

patterns.vi: Thú cưng yêu thích của bạn là gì?
examples: What is your favorite pet, Linh?
What is your favorite pet? I like cats.
What is his favorite pet? He likes dogs.

patterns.vi: Tôi thích + thú cưng + vì + lý do.
examples: I like dogs because they are friendly.
She likes fish because they are quiet.
He likes rabbits because they are cute.

patterns.pattern: We need to + care action + our pet.
patterns.vi: Chúng ta cần + hành động chăm sóc + thú cưng của mình.
examples: We need to feed our dog every day.
We need to clean the bird's cage.
We need to walk our puppy in the park.

grammar.title: Have got / Has got
grammar.explain_en: We use 'have got' to talk about things we own. Use 'have got' with I, you, we, they. Use 'has got' with he, she, it.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'have got' để nói về những thứ mình sở hữu. Dùng 'have got' với I, you, we, they. Dùng 'has got' với he, she, it.
examples: I have got a pet dog.
My sister has got a small cat.
They have got many colorful fish.

grammar.title: Can / Can't
grammar.explain_en: We use 'can' to talk about ability (what someone or something is able to do). We use 'can't' (cannot) to talk about inability.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'can' để nói về khả năng (ai đó hoặc cái gì đó có thể làm được). Chúng ta dùng 'can't' (cannot) để nói về việc không thể làm được.
examples: A bird can fly.
My dog can run very fast.
A fish can't walk, but it can swim.
grammar.wrong: ❌ My cat can to jump high.

grammar.title: Present Simple for description
grammar.explain_en: We use the Present Simple to talk about facts or things that are always true. We use it to describe our pets and their habits.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì Hiện tại đơn để nói về các sự thật hoặc những điều luôn đúng. Chúng ta dùng nó để mô tả thú cưng và thói quen của chúng.
examples: My dog has brown fur.
Rabbits like to eat carrots.
My cat sleeps a lot during the day.
grammar.right: ✅ A hamster lives in a cage.
grammar.wrong: ❌ A hamster is living in a cage.

grammar.title: Present Continuous for actions happening now
grammar.explain_en: We use the Present Continuous to talk about actions that are happening right now, at this moment.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn để nói về những hành động đang diễn ra ngay bây giờ, tại thời điểm nói.
examples: Look! My puppy is playing with a ball.
The cat is sleeping on the sofa right now.
My fish are swimming in the bowl.
grammar.right: ✅ What is your dog doing? It is barking.
grammar.wrong: ❌ What is your dog doing? It bark.

readings.title: MY PET DOG, LUCKY
readings.text: Hello! My name is Nam. I am eight years old. I have got a pet dog. His name is Lucky. Lucky is a puppy. He is small and friendly. Lucky has got brown fur and a short tail. He loves to play with me in the park. He can run very fast. Lucky likes to eat dog food and sometimes a small bone. I feed him every morning and evening. Lucky is a very good boy. I love my dog, Lucky, very much.
readings.image_prompt: A happy Vietnamese boy, Nam, smiling and gently petting his small, brown puppy named Lucky in a park setting.
questions: Is Lucky a big dog or a puppy?
Does Lucky have a long tail or a short tail?
Where does Lucky like to play?

readings.title: MY PETS, GOLDIE AND FLUFFY
readings.text: Hi, I'm Mia. I live with my parents and my two pets. I have got a fish named Goldie and a cat named Fluffy. Goldie lives in a big glass bowl. She is orange and shiny. She likes to swim around all day. I feed Goldie small fish food flakes every morning. Fluffy is a black cat. She has soft fur and green eyes. Fluffy loves to sleep and play. Sometimes, she catches small toys. Right now, Fluffy is sleeping on my bed. Goldie is swimming fast because I just fed her. I love my pets very much. They are part of my family.
readings.image_prompt: A cheerful Vietnamese girl, Mia, sitting between a clear fish bowl with an orange fish and a sleeping black cat on a cozy bed. Both pets are visible and happy.
questions: How many pets does Mia have?
What does Goldie like to do?
What kind of fur does Fluffy have?
What is Fluffy doing right now?

true_false.statement: Fluffy is sleeping on the floor.

readings.title: TAKING CARE OF MY PETS
readings.text: My name is Ben, and I have two pets: a rabbit named Cotton and a bird named Sky. Cotton has very white fur and long ears. He lives in a clean cage in our garden. I feed him fresh carrots and special rabbit food every day. I also clean his cage once a week because rabbits like to be clean. Sky is a small blue bird. She has a beautiful singing voice. Sky lives in a cage inside our house. I give her bird seeds and fresh water. My mom helps me clean Sky's cage every two days. It is important to take good care of our pets. They need food, water, and a clean home. Playing with them is also important because they need exercise and love. My pets are happy, and I am happy too because I love watching them play. Taking care of pets teaches me responsibility.
readings.image_prompt: A happy diverse boy, Ben, in a garden, holding a white rabbit named Cotton, while a small blue bird named Sky is in a cage hanging nearby. Ben is smiling as he looks at Cotton.
questions: How often does Ben clean Cotton's cage?

listening.script: Hello, everyone! Today, I want to tell you about my pets. I have two pets. One is a cat, and her name is Mimi. Mimi has soft white fur and a long tail. She likes to sleep on my bed, and she loves to chase toys. Right now, she is sleeping under my chair. My other pet is a small fish named Bubbles. Bubbles is orange and lives in a glass bowl. He loves to swim around his bowl all day long. I feed Mimi cat food every morning and evening. I feed Bubbles fish flakes once a day. I always give them fresh water. I clean Mimi's litter box every day and Bubbles' bowl once a week. Taking care of my pets is a big job, but they bring me a lot of joy. What about your pets?

life_skill.title: BE RESPONSIBLE FOR YOUR PETS
life_skill.intro: Having a pet is fun, but it's also a big responsibility. Pets need your care and love to be healthy and happy.
life_skill.intro_vi: Có thú cưng rất vui, nhưng đó cũng là một trách nhiệm lớn. Thú cưng cần sự chăm sóc và tình yêu thương của bạn để khỏe mạnh và hạnh phúc.
can_do: Give my pet fresh water every day.
Clean my pet's cage/bowl/litter box regularly.
Take my pet to the vet if it's sick.
life_skill.value_question: What is one thing you can do today to be more responsible for your pet or any animal?
life_skill.image_prompt: A diverse group of cheerful Vietnamese children showing different acts of pet care: one feeding a fish, one walking a dog, one cleaning a hamster cage, all looking happy and responsible.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Cats sleep for about 70% of their lives! That's a lot of napping!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Mèo ngủ khoảng 70% cuộc đời của chúng! Ngủ thật nhiều!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Dogs' noses are like fingerprints – no two are exactly alike!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Mũi của chó giống như dấu vân tay – không có hai chiếc mũi nào giống hệt nhau!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Goldfish have a memory of about three seconds, but some studies say it can be longer!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Cá vàng có trí nhớ khoảng ba giây, nhưng một số nghiên cứu cho rằng nó có thể dài hơn!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Rabbits can live for about 8 to 12 years if they are well cared for!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Thỏ có thể sống khoảng 8 đến 12 năm nếu chúng được chăm sóc tốt!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Hamsters carry food in their cheeks, which can get very big!
fun_facts.vi: Bạn có biết không? Chuột Hamster mang thức ăn trong má của chúng, những chiếc má này có thể phình rất to!

project.title: MY DREAM PET POSTER
project.task: Create a poster about your dream pet. Draw your dream pet and write 5-8 sentences about it.
draw_items: Your dream pet (e.g., a big dog, a small cat, a colorful bird)
A park or garden where it plays
A happy face on your pet
example: This is my dream pet. It is a big, friendly dog named Max.
Max has got soft, black fur and a long tail.
He can run very fast and catch a ball.
Max loves to eat dog treats and play in the park.
I will walk Max every day and give him lots of love.
Max will be my best friend!

classroom_game.name: Pet Charades
steps_en: Divide the class into small groups.
Each group gets a list of pet names (e.g., dog, cat, fish, bird, rabbit, hamster).
One student from a group acts out a pet without speaking. The others guess.
The first group to guess correctly gets a point. The group with the most points wins!
steps_vi: Chia lớp thành các nhóm nhỏ.
Mỗi nhóm nhận một danh sách tên thú cưng (ví dụ: chó, mèo, cá, chim, thỏ, chuột hamster).
Một học sinh trong nhóm sẽ diễn tả một con vật mà không nói. Các bạn khác đoán.
Nhóm nào đoán đúng đầu tiên sẽ được một điểm. Nhóm có nhiều điểm nhất sẽ thắng!
